# Sistemėlė

> Sistemėlė ("a little system" in Lithuanian) is an open-source, MIT-licensed starter for running a small business, or building client systems as an agency, on Cloudflare Workers. One Worker serves the API, a server-rendered public website, an MCP endpoint and a React dashboard. Data lives in Cloudflare D1 (SQLite); email goes through Resend.

## Get started

- [Source code](https://github.com/aimantas/sistemele): repository with `AGENTS.md`, a README per module and the full setup guide
- Install: `npx degit aimantas/sistemele my-business && cd my-business && npm install && npm run setup && npm run dev`, then `npm run deploy`
- Agent skill: `npx skills add aimantas/sistemele`
- Requirements: Node 22 and a Cloudflare account; a Resend account for email

## Modules

Switch modules on or off in `sistemele.config.ts`. Modules talk through typed events: an accepted quote marks the deal won; an issued invoice deducts stock.

- CRM: contacts, drag-and-drop deal pipeline, notes, tasks, website requests
- Catalog and stock: products and services, stock ledger, low-stock alerts, public product pages with Product structured data
- Quotes: priced offers customers open and accept from a private link
- Invoices: gap-free numbering, VAT per rate, payments, overdue tracking, bank-transfer instructions, public invoice link

## Dashboard

Drag-and-drop dashboard with per-user layouts saved in D1, KPI cards from any module, and templates (Owner, Sales, Operations, Minimal). `AGENTS.md` documents how to add widgets and templates.

## For AI agents

- MCP endpoint at `/mcp` on every installation (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC). Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API token>`; the token's role (owner, admin or member) limits which tools it can call.
- Each installation publishes `/llms.txt`, and its public pages answer `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Built in

- Passwordless magic-link sign-in; owner, admin and member roles; audit log
- CSRF protection, security headers, rate limits, server-authoritative totals
- Server-rendered public pages with unique titles, canonical URLs, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap.xml and robots.txt; preview deployments are never indexed
- Stack: Hono, React 19, React Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS v4, Zod, Vite with the Cloudflare plugin, Vitest with a real local D1
